#{endTime} and i.bus_type is not null and i.PRAC_TRADE_AMOUNT is NOT NULL and is_Agreement_Impl='0' and (i.quarter_Rep_Status is NULL or i.quarter_Rep_Status <> '1') and i.delflag_='1' group by i.CONTRACT_NO
union all select i.CONTRACT_NO ,max(i.TRAN_DATE)as tranDate ,max(i.REL_NAME) as relName, max(r.relStatement) as relStatement ,max(i.TRAN_TYPE) as TRANTYPE , max(i.tran_Name) as tranName ,sum(i.prac_Trade_Amount)as contractAmount,max(i.pid) as pid,max(i.bus_Type) as busType from ins_tra_other i INNER join bus_rel r on r.to_pid = i.rel_id where i.TRAN_DATE between #{startTime} and #{endTime} and i.bus_type is not null and i.PRAC_TRADE_AMOUNT is NOT NULL and (i.quarter_Rep_Status is NULL or i.quarter_Rep_Status <> '1') and i.delflag_='1' group by i.CONTRACT_NO
